"# Walkthrough - Restricting Lite Mode to Home Page (Hiding Control Panel)

Based on the requirements that Pro mode is for experts (not paid) and Lite mode is for regular users, we have restricted Lite mode strictly to the Home page context. The sidebar control panel with 22 tabs and the bottom navigation cards grid on the Home page are hidden in Lite mode.

## Changes Made

### Frontend Changes

#### [index.html](file:///c:/Users/Зефирка/StartUp/index.html)
- Added the `hidden` class and `id="home-lite-bottom-cards"` to the grid of 4 cards inside `home-lite-content` (lines 315-339) to hide them permanently in Lite mode.
- Verified that in Lite mode, the sidebar category blocks (`.category-block`) and search block (`#sidebar-search`) are hidden via existing JavaScript logic, effectively hiding all 22 navigation tabs.
- Verified that the `pro-feature-modal` styling correctly reflects that Pro Mode is for experts (rather than being a paid upgrade).

## Verification & Testing Results

### Manual Verification
1. Opened the MVP dashboard with `currentProductMode = 'lite'`.
2. Hiding of the sidebar navigation categories (22 tabs) and search bar in Lite mode was verified.
3. Hiding of the 4 bottom navigation cards on the Home page in Lite mode was verified (only the Active Context selector and the Quick Start panel remain visible).
4. Swapping modes using the Pro toggle switch was verified:
   - Clicking Pro immediately renders the developer console (`home-pro-content`) and restores the 22 navigation tabs in the sidebar.
   - Clicking Lite returns the interface to the simplified single-page dashboard.
"
